column4: machine learning techniques that aim to make models more efficient, cost-effective, and accessible while maintaining or even improving their performance

artificial intelligence paradigm that combines a knowledge base representing knowledge explicitly and an inference engine generating outputs through logical reasoning on the knowledge base, to solve application problems
artificial intelligence approach governed by human-defined rules that explicitly dictate behaviour, relying on logical statements (rules) to determine actions in specific situations
programming approach designed to tackle problems for which there lacks a systematic or optimized approach, frequently used in expert systems

sub-field of AI dealing with the encoding of
knowledge in a form that can be used for computer-based problem solving
a subfield of computer science and artificial intelligence focused on enabling computers to understand and communicate with human language

automated process of selecting and analysing large amounts of text or data resources to discover patterns, relationships, and semantic insights that provide valuable information for research and decision-making

automated process of converting text or speech from one language (source language) to another (target language) using computational models and algorithms for accurate and contextually appropriate translations
process of assigning predefined labels to text data in order to automatically categorise it into groups

software or program designed to simulate human-like conversation with a user through messaging platforms, websites, mobile apps, or telephone systems, often employing natural language processing and machine learning to engage in conversation mimicking human interaction
artificial intelligence field that uses agents to interpret and understand information from their environment through sensory inputs
acquisition of information about an object or phenomenon without physical contact, typically using aerial sensor technologies

interdisciplinary scientific field that enables computers to analyze and understand visual data from images and videos, automatically extracting meaningful information to identify patterns, defects, or make decisions

computer vision technology that detects instances of semantic objects in digital images and videos, covering domains like face detection and pedestrian detection, with applications spanning image retrieval and video surveillance
computer vision technology employing biometric analysis and mapping of facial characteristics for facial identification purposes, recognising and verifying an individual's identity
computer vision technology that identifies, categorises and recognises objects, places, people, text and actions in digital images

automated identification of patterns and regularities in data, utilising algorithms to detect patterns or regularities for categorising data into distinct groups, encompassing diverse applications such as image analysis, speech processing, and biometric authentication

computer vision technology that identifies and categorises objects, scenes, activities, and other visual elements in images or video, and includes image classification, object detection, scene understanding, and visual pattern recognition

process of deriving meaningful information about motion from visual data, including tracking objects across frames, analysing trajectories, estimating velocity and acceleration, and interpreting the meaning of motion patterns
process of categorising and labelling groups of pixels or vectors within an image based on particular rules, involving the assignment of images to predefined classes or categories
artificial intelligence model that can learn from and mimic large amounts of data to create content such as text, images, music, videos, code, and more, based on inputs or prompts
deep learning model that uses artificial neural networks trained on vast amounts of data to understand and generate natural language and other types of content to perform a wide range of tasks
computer systems that emulate human creative processes and produce artistic, design output that simulates innovation and originality

a field of study in artificial intelligence concerned with the development and study of statistical algorithms that can learn from data and generalize to unseen data, and thus perform tasks without explicit instructions

machine learning subfield that uses multi-layer neural networks (deep neural networks) to learn data representations at different levels of abstraction, facilitating progressive learning and improvement of the representation and transformation of input data

computational model consisting of units called 'artificial neurons' interconnected by weighted edges, which loosely model the neurons and synapses in the brain. Each artificial neuron receives weighted input signals from connected neurons, processes them by computing a weighted sum, and then applies an activation function to produce an output signal that is sent to other connected neurons
a technique in machine learning in which knowledge learned from a task is re-used in order to boost performance on a related task

machine learning approach that uses labelled datasets to train artificial intelligence algorithms to recognise patterns and correlations between input features and outputs, with the aim of developing a model that can accurately predict outcomes for unseen real-world data
machine learning approach that combines supervised and unsupervised learning by using both labeled and unlabeled data to train artificial intelligence models for classification and regression tasks

supervised learning approach, applicable to classification and regression tasks, featuring a hierarchical, tree-like structure with root, branch, internal- and leaf-nodes, employed in statistics, data mining, and machine learning as a predictive model to infer conclusions about observations

machine learning approach that uses unlabelled data to analyse and cluster data without human intervention to reveal hidden patterns or groupings, often used in statistics, data mining and related fields
machine learning approach based on Bayesian networks, probabilistic models based on directed acyclic graphs, enabling a direct representation of causal relations between variables

machine learning approach that uses unsupervised learning for tasks that typically require supervision, generating implicit labels from unstructured data, where models are trained on a task using the data itself to provide supervisory signals, often used in neural networks to exploit inherent structures or relationships within input data to generate training signals

machine learning approach that focuses on decision making by autonomous agents capable of making independent decisions and responding to their environment without direct human instruction, addressing sequential decision problems in uncertain environments

machine-based system demonstrating varying degrees of autonomy and adaptiveness after deployment, generating outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations, or decisions to influence physical or virtual environments
artificial intelligence system based on a general-purpose model and capable of serving a variety of purposes, either in direct use or integrated with other AI systems

artificial intelligence systems that uses available information to generate predictions, make inferences and draw conclusions, involving the representation of data in machine-processable form and application of logic to arrive at decisions

artificial intelligence system emulating human expert decision-making abilities, addressing complex problems through reasoning across knowledge bases primarily represented as if-then rules, and comprising two sub-systems: an inference engine for applying rules to known facts and deducing new facts, and a knowledge base containing facts and rules; potentially featuring explanation and debugging capabilities
technology focused on automation of repetitive, routine, rule-based human tasks
the science of designing, engineering and using robots, i.e. machines controlled by computers which perform jobs automatically

the deployment and execution of AI and ML models on Edge devices, including smartphones, IoT sensors, industrial controllers, and other resource-constrained devices located at the Edge of the network and closer to the data sources
engineered system built from, and depending upon, the seamless integration of computation and physical components
